name: taskplane
description: Orchestrator-led software delivery for Claude and Codex, with native tools, practical verification, and advisory progress and token telemetry.

interface.longDescription: The orchestrator carries the requested outcome through Product, Design when needed, Plan, Build, verification, and handoff. Native tools and host permissions govern execution. Local telemetry records progress, activity, and available native token counters; advisory signals highlight repetition and possible overengineering without blocking the flow or imposing a token cap.
capabilities: Execute authorized work through verified output
Keep the orchestrator accountable for delivery
Record meaningful progress and native token observations
Flag repeated actions and possible overengineering as advice
Review source and designs with proportionate evidence
Preserve native host permissions and user decisions
defaultPrompt: taskplane design this feature before implementation and show me the key choices.
taskplane build this feature and ask me only for material decisions.
taskplane review this branch without changing code.
